title: A multi-nutrient nanocomposite enhances UV stress tolerance and modulates nutrient accumulation in lettuce
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2025, Accepted Manuscript
DOI: 10.1039/D5EN00154D, Paper
Raja muthuramalingam Thangavelu, Washington da Silva, Jose Angel Hernandez-Viezcas, Vinka Oyanedel Craver, Jorge L. Gardea-Torresdey, Christian Dimkpa, Jason C. White, Nubia Zuverza-Mena
